description: Gzip size budgets for production Web build artifacts under static/. Per-asset rules cap each matching file. aggregateRules cap the unique gzip total of a family so splitting one route or component into many smaller chunks cannot bypass the per-asset budgets (Refs #883). Initial per-asset baseline = measured gzip size * 1.10 (ceil). Aggregate already-split families use measured sum + 400 B. Tighten deliberately in follow-up tasks; do not raise budgets to hide regressions without justification.
